title: Import clients, staff, services or products
summary: Use a CSV template, review the preview and choose how duplicate rows should be handled.

sections.title: Prepare a clean file
sections.body: You need business-wide settings access. Importing is optional. Download the template for the record type you intend to import and keep a copy of your original file. Include only information your business is entitled to use.

sections.title: Required information and price format
sections.body:
Clients need a name; staff need a name and email; services need a name, price and duration; products need a name and SKU. Keep a stable external reference when your source file supplies one.

For service and product prices, the template’s price field uses the currency’s smallest unit: for a currency with two decimal places, enter 2500 for 25.00. Follow the selected currency’s format, and check the preview before importing.

sections.title: Preview and import
sections.body:
1. Open **Business setup → Optional setup → Import records**.
2. Choose **Record type**: Clients, Staff, Services or Products.
3. Select the matching link under **Download a template** and use its headings as a starting point.
4. Choose your **CSV file**. In **Map columns**, match each field to a column in the file. Choose **Do not import** for fields you intentionally omit.
5. Select **Validate and preview**. Read the invalid-row and duplicate counts.
6. For each **Duplicate decision**, choose **Update matched record**, **Create separately** or **Skip row** deliberately. Correct invalid values in the source file and preview again when necessary.
7. Select **Start import** for the reviewed preview.

For existing services, choose **Skip row**. Change their price, duration and future availability through Services, where you can review the effect on appointments.

sections.title: Verify the result
sections.body: Read the import result and inspect several affected records in Clients, Team & availability, Services or Inventory. An import does not publish your booking page. Imported team or service records may still need branch assignments and working hours before they are bookable.

sections.title: If rows need attention
sections.body: Use the row number and message to correct the file, then validate it again. Avoid creating a separate record for a known existing client just to remove a duplicate warning. Do not assume all rows were imported because the upload completed.
